title: Output Upgrade
text: Right-click the held plate to configure directions and filters before installing it. Settings remain on the plate after removal.
Enable any of six sides to push into adjacent containers at a base 4 items or 2000 mB per second, increased by Speed Upgrades. Enabled directions are visited in order.
Uses the same filters as Intake Upgrades. Output, external extraction and resonance use independent rate allowances.
